name: Mynori
source:
From time to time, the main character is overtaken by memories from the past. He is a soldier and goes on a mission. Memories from the past will influence his next actions.

[Translated from [url=https://kira-uazis.itch.io/munory]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
主角时不时地会被过去的记忆所占据。他是一名军人，肩负着使命。过去的记忆会影响他接下来的行动。

[译自[url=https://kira-uazis.itch.io/munory]itch.io[/url]]
